cents.: Personal Expense Tracker

Live • 2026

Built a privacy-first personal expense tracker with no framework and no build step. Just vanilla ES modules. Type a plain-language entry like “lidl groceries 4.47 revolut” and it auto-parses amount, category, and payment method. Data stays on the device in localStorage, with optional cloud sync to a Cloudflare KV store and a private GitHub mirror as the backup copy, across separate profiles and locked behind a PIN or Face ID / fingerprint.

JavaScript ES Modules localStorage Cloudflare KV Web Auth API
